editorial.headline: Forestry Support Services With a Clear Bali Path
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers specialist forestry support, nationally open to PMA ownership and not blocked by Bali’s current moratorium, subject to address verification.
editorial.body:
This KBLI activity is for the practical service layer around forestry: the work that supports forest operations without becoming the forest business itself. Its scope includes forest inventory, forestry management consulting, timber evaluation, forest-fire prevention, forest-pest control, and the rental of forestry equipment when supplied with an operator. It also reaches timber-harvesting support where the movement of timber inside the forest is associated with harvesting activity.

That makes the code useful for operators whose business is built around expertise, field teams, equipment, and technical execution rather than ownership of the forest resource. A company using this classification may be positioning itself as a forestry consultant, a technical contractor, a prevention or control specialist, or an operational support provider for harvesting logistics inside the forest area. The record is also explicit about boundaries: it is not a catch-all for every activity that happens in or near a forest. The included work is service support to forestry and timber harvesting; other environmental, construction, utility, conservation, or energy activities are outside this scope.

On scale, the classification is unusually broad. The record opens it to Mikro, Kecil, Menengah, and Besar operators, so it can fit both small specialist teams and larger service companies. Nationally, the foreign-investment position is also clean: PMA status is TERBUKA, with a foreign ownership ceiling of 100%, sourced to Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021. In plain terms, the national record does not impose a foreign-share cap below full ownership for this activity.

The Bali reading is equally important, because many KBLI records that look open nationally can still fail at provincial registration level. Here, the record says the Bali status is OK_or_HIGHER_RISK and l4_bali_blocked is false. The stated reason is that medium-high/high risk is not blocked by the Bali moratorium, although the address must still be verified. That means the honest lede is not a warning of a Bali shutdown: for this forestry-support activity, a foreign-owned company is not blocked by the Bali province moratorium on the face of the record. The careful caveat is narrower and factual: registration should still be checked against the specific address.
